provenance: Fresh isolated profile; zero initial records. Ordinary stage taps, arrow-key movement and Space dashes. Frozen maps and read-only model snapshots assist the route planner. Three genuine real-time attempts, 3 wins; each winning run includes all ten gems and optional key/chest. No save fixtures, state/model writes, direct model.update, clock changes, replay manipulation, microphone or external music. Assisted real-time play, not a human completion-time claim.
